title: Sweet Paneer Nutty Delight
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dessert made with paneer, sweet ingredients, and nutty goodness. Perfect for gluten-free diets.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, combine paneer, sweet and nutty ingredients.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
5. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
6. Serve cold, garnished with additional chopped nuts if desired.
